condition_module_description: The components of your customers' units: each one's condition over time, worked out from the checklists, its status, its article in the shop and its service history, and planning the critical ones.
condition_legend_critical: Condition below {critical}% or inspection expired — plan within {days} working days.
condition_legend_attention: Condition below {attention}%, a rejected inspection point or open advice — take it along at the next visit.
condition_legend_planned: Work on it is in the planning; the mark beside it says what it needs.
condition_legend_ok: Within interval and inspection valid — no action.
condition_feed_description: What happened to the units lately: orders, work orders and conditions.
condition_feed_empty: Nothing has happened to these units yet.
condition_card_description: The unit's latest condition, and how it went.
condition_record_component_description: A correction from the office: it counts until a newer condition, e.g. the next completed checklist's.
condition_record_description: The latest condition is the unit's, until the next completed checklist's; the earlier ones stay in its history.
condition_advice_placeholder: E.g. Replace the spring set (SD-001) — cycle counter above 90%.
condition_advice_description: Open advice makes the unit need attention until a newer condition says otherwise.
condition_parts_hint: Parts used are on the unit's orders.
condition_components_description: The unit's components: each one's condition, worked out from the checklist points that check it, its status and its article.
condition_components_none: No components yet: the unit's condition counts as a whole.
condition_component_dialog_description: A completed checklist gives the component a score from the points that check it.
condition_component_article_description: The material whose SKU the parts shop sells: a rejected point of the component suggests it first.
condition_component_checkpoints_descript: The points of the unit's checklist that check this component. Choosing an article checks its shop points.
condition_component_no_checkpoints: The unit's category has no checklist template, so there are no points to choose.
condition_component_remove_description: Its conditions go with it; the unit's own stay.
condition_component_article_not_found: That article isn't one of your materials.
condition_component_checkpoint_not_found: Those checklist points aren't the unit's.
condition_components_max: A unit has at most {max} components.
condition_not_in_progress: Order {number} isn't in progress: conditions are recorded while the work is under way.
condition_portal_ask: The checklist is completed. Any advice on the unit?
condition_portal_computed: Worked out from the checklist: the share of its points found OK.
condition_portal_no_score: The checklist gave no score: none of its points counted (all not applicable).
condition_settings_description: When a unit is critical or needs attention, and whether critical units are planned by themselves.
condition_critical_below_description: A unit whose condition is below this is critical, as is one whose inspection has expired.
condition_attention_below_description: A unit whose condition is below this needs attention.
condition_auto_plan_description: Each day, a critical unit without an open order gets a maintenance order, to be done within {days} working days.
condition_settings_managers: Only owners and admins change these settings.
condition_banner_intro: Every customer, component, preference and activity in one place. From the first sign to the completed checklist, in one line.
condition_step_link: Every component is linked to its unit, location and customer, with its article from the parts shop.
condition_step_monitor: A condition score from the findings on the checklists, and the inspections that are due.
condition_step_plan: The service interval sets the next visit; you plan the critical components straight away.
condition_step_record: The engineer completes the checklist; the condition, the inspection and the activity log follow.
